summary: Return products with positive stock, optionally filtered by a provided tag, sorted by SKU in ascending order.
inputs: tag (str): Optional tag used to filter products; if empty, no tag-based filtering is applied.
self.products (Dict[Any, Product]): Internal mapping of products from which values are read and filtered.
outputs: available_products (List[Product]): List of in-stock products, optionally filtered by tag, sorted by product.sku ascending.
main_effect: Sort values by product.sku in ascending order and produce final list

control_structures.code:
if tag:
            values = [product for product in values if tag in product.tags]

assignments.code: values = [product for product in self.products.values() if product.stock > 0]
